user.title: Set up HA Fitness
user.description: Enter the address of the HA Fitness app. Under the Supervisor you don't need this: the app is found by itself and shows under Discovered.

hassio_confirm.title: HA Fitness app found
hassio_confirm.description: Set up HA Fitness with the app the Supervisor found?

error.cannot_connect: The HA Fitness app can't be reached at this URL.

abort.already_configured: HA Fitness is already set up.

unsupported_api_version.title: The HA Fitness app and integration don't match
unsupported_api_version.description: The HA Fitness app speaks API version {api_version}, and this version of the integration supports API version {supported}. Update the HA Fitness integration in HACS, then restart Home Assistant. Until then, HA Fitness is unavailable.

addon_too_old.title: The HA Fitness app is too old
addon_too_old.description: This version of the HA Fitness integration needs a newer HA Fitness app. Update the HA Fitness app. The integration connects again by itself.

skip.name: Skip training day
skip.description: Skips an open training day on purpose. It doesn't count as a missed training day.

training_day_id.name: Training day ID
training_day_id.description: The ID of an open training day, as shown in the Training days attribute of Training today.

not_found.message: There is no training day with ID {training_day_id}.

not_open.message: Training day {training_day_id} is no longer open.

unavailable.message: The HA Fitness app can't be reached.
